name: L's Difficult Successors
source:
The player controls L. The goal is to convince Mello and Near to be intimate with each other before Watari comes back to the room. Their level of intimacy will be displayed in the shape of empty hearts (initially), that will be eventually filled as their attraction for each other raises. The more you manage to make Mello and Near attracted to each other, the further they will accept to go.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20110823093531/http://www.cursedmoons.com/fan/game/successors/]Cursed MoonS[/url]]
translation:
玩家控制L。目标是在Watari回到房间之前说服Mello和Near彼此亲密。他们的亲密程度会以空心的形式表现出来（一开始），随着他们对彼此的吸引力的增加，最终会被填满。你越能让梅洛和尼尔互相吸引，他们就越愿意走得更远。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20110823093531/http://www.cursedmoons.com/fan/game/successors/]被诅咒的月亮[/url]]
